digest.component_or_area: fsck snapshot rebuild and event compaction
propositions: fsck snapshot rebuild silently discards historical events that exist only in prior SNAPSHOT compiled_state but whose source files were deleted by pre-July-2026 compaction
Rebuild incorrectly replays from index 0 against incomplete log, causing folded source events to vanish and earlier status changes to become current state
fsck --repair-snapshots mutates store despite --dry-run flag, preventing safe preview of rebuild impact
rebuild_snapshot_from_full_log must fail-closed when SNAPSHOT cites source_event_uuids with no corresponding files on disk
Deleted source events must be restored from git history as .retired files to complete the log before rebuild, enabling auto-repair of affected tickets
